description: This file defines the AttributionDialogActivity class, an Android Activity that displays a dialog explaining the source of inline suggestions. It handles intent extras, creates dialogs with options to open settings, and manages activity lifecycle.

classes.name: AttributionDialogActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that shows a dialog explaining the source of inline fill suggestions, with options to view settings.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, retrieves intent extra, creates and displays the dialog.

methods.name: createDialog
methods.description: Builds and returns an AlertDialog with a descriptive message and buttons for settings or dismiss.
